raw.description:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

Rithum is an AI‑first organization, meaning AI is foundational to how we work, collaborate, and grow. Across all roles, employees are expected to leverage AI to move faster, work smarter, and create repeatable patterns that benefit others. AI proficiency is a core capability, reinforced through clear standards, tooling, and ongoing support. At Rithum, you contribute to advancing our AI‑first ways of working.

As the Director, Product Operations & Planning, you are responsible for defining and scaling the operating system that enables Product and Engineering to deliver with clarity, focus, and accountability. You serve as the connective layer between strategy and execution—translating company priorities into structured planning, aligned roadmaps, and disciplined delivery. You establish the frameworks, processes, and operating rhythms that drive portfolio visibility, prioritization, and execution consistency across the organization. In this role, you partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership to ensure teams are focused on the highest-impact work and that trade-offs are made intentionally and transparently. You bring rigor to how work is planned, tracked, and delivered—improving execution predictability, reducing friction, and enabling the organization to scale effectively. Your impact is measured by the organization’s ability to consistently deliver against priorities, maintain clear alignment, and build leadership confidence in product execution.

Responsibilities

Product Operating Model & Planning

  • Define, implement, and continuously evolve the Product & Engineering operating model, including planning, governance, and execution rhythms
  • Lead annual and quarterly planning processes (OKRs), ensuring clear alignment from company strategy through team-level execution
  • Establish and enforce roadmap governance and decision-making frameworks that drive clarity, accountability, and consistency

Portfolio Visibility & Prioritization

  • Build and maintain end-to-end portfolio visibility across initiatives, dependencies, capacity, and resource allocation
  • Develop and operationalize prioritization frameworks that balance strategic impact, client value, and operational constraints
  • Ensure product roadmaps are clear, aligned, and transparent across leadership and key stakeholders

Execution Excellence & Predictability

  • Implement systems, processes, and metrics that improve delivery predictability, throughput, and execution quality
  • Define and track product and operational performance metrics (e.g., roadmap health, delivery accuracy, cycle time, dependency risk)
  • Identify systemic risks and inefficiencies and drive continuous improvement across Product and Engineering

Cross-Functional Alignment & Influence

  • Drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Finance, and Commercial teams on priorities, sequencing, and trade-offs
  • Improve collaboration models and operating cadences to reduce friction and increase velocity
  • Influence leadership decisions through data-driven insights, structured problem-solving, and clear recommendations

AI-First Enablement

  • Leverage AI to enhance planning, forecasting, and operational insights
  • Identify opportunities to automate workflows and scale operational best practices
  • Champion adoption of AI-driven tools and processes across Product and Engineering

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in Product Operations, Program Management, Product Management, or related roles in a SaaS or technology environment
  • Proven experience building and scaling product operating models or planning functions that improve execution predictability and organizational alignment
  • Demonstrated success leading annual and quarterly planning processes (e.g., OKRs) across cross-functional teams
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment on priorities and trade-offs
  • Experience defining and operationalizing metrics that improve delivery outcomes, roadmap transparency, and organizational effectiveness
  • Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into scalable systems, processes, and measurable business outcomes

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; MBA a plus
  • Experience in high-growth or scaling SaaS organizations
  • Familiarity with portfolio management and prioritization frameworks
  • Experience integrating AI tools into operational workflows to drive efficiency and insight generation
  • Strong business and financial acumen, including understanding of investment trade-offs and resource allocation
  • Executive presence with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and concisely to senior leadership
  • Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, etc.) to accelerate and elevate your outcomes; including but not limited to communication drafting, data analysis, prompt engineering, and/or documentation

Travel Required

Up to 10%

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

What it’s like to work at Rithum

When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans.

At Rithum you will:

  • Partner with the leading brands and retailers.
  • Connect with passionate professionals who will help support your goals.
  • Participate in an inclusive, welcoming work atmosphere.
  • Achieve work-life balance through remote-first working conditions, generous time off, and wellness days.
  • Receive industry-competitive compensation and total rewards benefits.

We believe in transparency and fairness in our compensation practices.

For this position, the expected base pay range is: $180,000-$245,000 per year.

This range represents the base pay for the role across all U.S. locations and is determined based on market data, internal equity, and experience. Final compensation may vary depending on geographic location, skills, and relevant experience.In addition to base pay, we offer a discretionary bonus for non-sales roles, a comprehensive benefits package, and, where applicable, sales incentives.

For this position, the expected discretionary bonus is 15% of the annual base salary.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision benefits: Affordable health care plans and company HSA contributions, starting on Day 1
  • A 6% 401(k) match
  • Competitive time off package with 20 days of Paid Time Off, 9 Company-Paid holidays, 2 paid floating holidays, 7 paid sick days, 2 Wellness days, and 1 Paid Volunteer Day; at 3 years of service PTO increases to 22 days, and at 5 years it increases to 25 days
  • 12 weeks primary caregiver leave & 4 weeks secondary caregiver leave
  • Accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity insurance
  • Pet insurance
  • Legal assistance and identity theft insurance plans
  • Life insurance 2x salary
  • Access to the Calm app and the Employee Assistance Program
  • $65/month Remote work stipend for internet
  • Culture and team-building activities
  • Tuition assistance
  • Career development opportunities
  • Charitable contribution match up to $250 per year

Rithum is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other protected characteristic. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations in accordance with the law for qualified applicants. If you require assistance during the interview process due to a medical condition or need support accessing our website or completing the application process, please reach out to us by completing the Accommodations Request Form. Your comfort and accessibility are important to us, and we're here to ensure a seamless experience as you explore opportunities with our team.

Ministry Brands is looking fora Director of Content Marketingto join our growing team!

PositionOverview

The Director of Content Marketing is a strategic and hands-on leader responsible for building andoperatinga high-performing content engine that fuels demand generation, customer acquisition, and expansion. Content & Distribution Ownership

Content Strategy

SEO / GEO

Editorial & Copywriting

Social Media & Community

  • Turn content into ongoing interaction with prospects and customers

PR & External Communications

  • Manage and guide the PR firm to ensure alignment with positioning, messaging, and business priorities

  • Drive awareness and credibility through coordinated PR efforts

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate positioning and messaging into market-ready content

  • Work with Creative & Brand to ensure content is visually compelling and aligned to brand standards

  • Collaborate with Marketing Intelligence to measure performance and continuouslyoptimize

  • Align closely with Demand Gen,Customer,Lifecycle, and Sales to ensure content is driving measurable outcomes

WhatYou’llBe Measured On

Pipeline & Revenue Impact

  • Measurable contribution to pipeline creation and revenue across campaigns and portfolios

  • Impact on opportunity creation, deal acceleration, and closed-won revenue

Conversion Performance

  • Improvements in conversion rates across the funnel (lead→opportunity→closed-won)

  • Performance of content in driving engagement, conversion, and revenue outcomes

Demand Generation Impact

  • Effectiveness of content in supporting pipeline creation across portfolios

  • Performance within demand generation campaigns, paid programs, and customer marketing efforts

Organic Growth & Inbound Demand

Team Performance

Cross-Functional Impact

What Success Looks Like

  • Campaigns consistently outperform due to strong content execution

Through Nectar, we foster engagement andappreciation whileprovidingtangible ways to recognizegreat work.

It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Established in 1980, Berkowitz Pollack Brant (BPB) is a certified public accounting firm with a longstanding presence in South Florida and New York. BPB has earned a strong reputation for delivering high-quality tax, assurance, and advisory services and has been consistently recognized among the top 100 accounting firms in the United States.

Effective January 1, 2026, BPB was acquired by and combined with Baker Tilly, a leading global advisory, tax, and assurance firm. During this transition period, the firm operates as Baker Tilly X Berkowitz Pollack Brant, Advisors + CPAs, reflecting our integration into Baker Tilly’s expansive national and global network, enhanced resources, and broad range of opportunities.

Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast-to-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms.

Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.

Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring.

Baker Tilly is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.

Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Associate of Accounting & Advisory Services, to work in our Managed Solutions & Technology Group who is passionate about leveraging technology to enhance financial operations and deliver innovative solutions to clients. In this role, you will work closely with clients and internal engagement teams to support the implementation, optimization, and ongoing management of accounting and financial technology platforms.

The MST Senior Associate will play a key role in analyzing client processes, identifying opportunities for system improvements, and helping implement scalable technology solutions that improve efficiency, reporting accuracy, and operational performance. This position also involves mentoring junior team members and contributing to the successful delivery of client engagements within a dynamic professional services environment.

Industry Experience

The MST Senior Associate will operate in a fast-paced consulting environment where accounting expertise and technology solutions interact. This role requires a strong understanding of financial systems, data management, and operational workflows in order to help clients modernize their accounting processes.

Experience with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, financial reporting tools, and accounting platforms is highly valuable in delivering effective technology-driven solutions that align with business and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

• Support and lead portions of client engagements related to financial system implementations, accounting technology optimization, and managed accounting solutions.

• Analyze client accounting processes and workflows to identify opportunities for automation, efficiency improvements, and technology enhancements.

• Assist with the configuration, implementation, and support of accounting systems and ERP platforms.

• Troubleshoot system issues and provide ongoing operational support for financial software applications.

• Develop and maintain documentation related to system configurations, workflows, and client procedures.

• Collaborate with clients and internal teams to gather business requirements and translate them into practical system solutions.

• Assist in the development of financial dashboards, reporting tools, and analytics solutions that provide clients with actionable business insights.

• Review work performed by associates and provide guidance, mentorship, and training to junior team members.

• Communicate regularly with engagement teams and clients to ensure projects remain on schedule and deliverables meet quality standards.

• Stay current on emerging accounting technologies, automation tools, and industry best practices to support continuous improvement in service delivery.

Skills and Qualifications

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with the capacity to interpret financial data and system outputs.

• Solid understanding of accounting processes, financial reporting, and internal controls.

• Experience working with accounting software or ERP platforms such as NetSuite, Sage, QuickBooks, or similar financial systems.

• Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, client-focused consulting environment.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.

• Interest in technology-enabled accounting solutions, automation, and financial data analytics.

Education and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Information Systems, Finance, Business Analytics, or a related field is required.

• Three (3) to Five (5) years of relevant professional experience in accounting, consulting, financial systems support, or technology implementation.

• Experience working with ERP systems, financial reporting tools, or data analytics platforms is preferred.

• Professional certifications such as CPA, CMA, or relevant technology certifications are a plus but not required.

What We Offer:

  • A competitive and equitable workplace.

  • Professional development and career growth opportunities.

  • A diverse and inclusive culture

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

  • Develop your telecom expertise in diverse portfolio of BICS products, including Voice, Cloud, Signaling, LTE, IoT, etc.

Tieto - BICS team has been growing since 2010… and we are looking forward to growing with you!

Role Purpose:

The Roaming business Expert is responsible for representing the commercial interests of a designated customer in all roaming-related negotiations with international mobile network operators (MNOs). The role ensures that Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) agreements are aligned with the customer’s strategic goals and budget expectations, while maintaining strong industry relationships and ensuring compliance with regulatory and contractual frameworks.

Responsibilities

  • Customer Representation:
    • Act as the commercial voice of the customer in all IOT negotiations, ensuring their strategic and financial objectives are met.
    • Translate customer P&L targets into negotiation strategies and commercial outcomes.
  • Negotiation & Contract Management:
    • Lead bilateral and multilateral negotiations with roaming partners and groups to secure optimal IOT terms.
    • Ensure contracts reflect agreed commercial conditions and are aligned with GSMA standards and RAEX processes.
    • Monitor contract lifecycle and proactively manage renewals and amendments.
  • Financial Reconciliation & Settlements:
    • Perform regular reconciliations between operational and financial data (e.g., invoices, payments, service delivery, usage reports).
    • Validate and process settlement reports, ensuring accuracy of financial postings and balances.
    • Perform Monthly Accruals for discounted commercial deals.
    • Support monthly and quarterly financial closing activities, ensuring all settlements are captured and accrued correctly.
  • Commercial Strategy & Analysis:
    • Analyse roaming traffic, cost trends, and partner performance to identify negotiation opportunities.
    • Collaborate with finance, pricing, and analytics teams to model commercial scenarios and assess impact on customer P&L.
    • Support the development of roaming pricing strategies and discount frameworks.
  • Stakeholder Engagement:
    • Maintain strong working relationships with internal stakeholders (e.g., finance, legal, operations) and external roaming partners.
    • Provide regular updates and reporting to the customer on negotiation progress, risks, and outcomes.
  • Market Intelligence & Compliance:
    • Stay informed on industry trends, regulatory developments, and competitive benchmarks.
    • Ensure all agreements comply with GSMA guidelines, roaming regulations, and internal governance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Telecommunications, or related field
  • 3–7 years of experience in roaming, wholesale, or telecom commercial roles
  • Experience negotiating IOT agreements or managing roaming partnerships
  • Fluency in verbal and spoken English; additional languages are a plus
  • Strong presentation skills

Personal Skills

  • Growth Mindset: Eager to learn, adapt, and continuously improve negotiation strategies and outcomes
  • Can-Do Attitude: Proactive, solution-oriented, and resilient in the face of challenges
  • Accountability: Takes ownership of deliverables and follows through on commitments
  • Collaborative Spirit: Easy to work with, respectful, and able to build trust across cultures and teams
  • Professionalism: Maintains a high standard of integrity, discretion, and customer focus in all interactions

Description

TripleTen is an online teaching platform that empowers people, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions. Our bootcamps focus on training students in Data Analytics, Data Science, Web Development, Quality Assurance (QA) Engineering, and UX/UI Design — in an accessible and practical way, supporting them until they successfully thrive in a new career.

🚀 Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry.

What is our goal?

We are continuously looking for experienced UX/UI Design professionals who want to support and guide our students on their path to becoming professional developers. This is a full-time teaching role with an expectation of 40 hours per week. The schedule can be flexible, but you must be consistently available to support students throughout their learning journey.

How to apply?

Apply here. We review applications on a rolling basis and invite selected candidates to record an introductory video where you answer a few questions, and complete a short technical test task.

If a vacancy is available, we will assign it to you right away; otherwise, we will keep your profile and completed task on file for future opportunities.

📌 Please submit your CV in English.

What you will do

  • Host regular live Q&A sessions to help students unblock and progress confidently
  • Offer personalized support through 1:1 video calls to answer questions and guide assignments
  • Occasionally respond to student questions via direct messages
  • Lead live lessons on core program topics and industry-relevant skills
  • Share your professional insights and best practices to support the learning community
  • Review student projects and provide feedback based on program standards
  • Write clear, actionable feedback to help students improve and meet expectations
  • Support students in text by explaining concepts, troubleshooting code, and clarifying project or review questions

Requirements

We require over 3 years of hands-on experience in UX/UI Design, with expertise in:

  • Design Thinking and Visual Design: Proven proficiency in applying user-centered design principles, creating visually appealing and functional designs, and adjusting them based on user needs and feedback.

raw.excerpt: über uns – talentspring academy group Was passiert, wenn Millionen Menschen nicht mithalten können – aber die Arbeitswelt längst weiterzieht?
raw.description:
über uns – talentspring academy group

Was passiert, wenn Millionen Menschen nicht mithalten können – aber die Arbeitswelt längst weiterzieht? Über 6 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland verfügen über keinen anerkannten Berufsabschluss. Gleichzeitig transformieren KI, Automatisierung und digitale Geschäftsmodelle ganze Branchen – schneller, als das Bildungssystem reagieren kann. In nahezu allen zukunftsrelevanten Sektoren fehlen qualifizierte Fachkräfte. Der Fachkräftemangel ist längst strukturell – und mit ihm wächst die Dringlichkeit, Menschen gezielt und wirksam neu zu qualifizieren.
Genau hier setzen wir an: Mit digitalen, staatlich geförderten Weiterbildungen, die Menschen beruflich neu aufstellen, Chancengleichheit stärken, digitale Kompetenzen breit vermitteln – und so den Wirtschaftsstandort Deutschland langfristig zukunftsfähig machen.

Die Talentspring Academy Group ist ein dynamisch wachsender Verbund staatlich anerkannter digital-first Bildungseinrichtungen mit klarem Fokus auf digitale Berufsfelder. Wir qualifizieren Menschen ohne formalen Abschluss, Quereinsteiger:innen und Arbeitssuchende und Arbeitnehmende für gefragte Tätigkeiten in der digitalen Arbeitswelt – staatlich zertifiziert, praxisnah und anschlussfähig. Unsere Programme qualifizieren für zukunftsrelevante Berufsfelder in Bereichen wie Künstliche Intelligenz, Online Marketing und Digital Sales – flexibel gestaltet, arbeitsmarktnah und mit echten Karriereperspektiven.

Was uns besonders macht: Wir verbinden die Geschwindigkeit und Innovationskraft eines EdTechs mit der Reichweite und Glaubwürdigkeit etablierter Bildungsstrukturen. Durch strategische Partnerschaften im Bildungssektor verfügen wir über eine bundesweite Infrastruktur mit mehreren hundert Standorten, tiefem institutionellem Vertrauen und direktem Zugang zu unseren Zielgruppen – über digitale wie lokale Kanäle. Das schafft Marktzugang, Vertrauen und nachhaltige Skalierbarkeit in einem regulierten Umfeld.

Wir stehen vor dem nächsten Wachstumsschub – mit klarem Produkt-Markt-Fit, KI-first-DNA, gesellschaftlichem Hebel und einem einzigartigen Marktzugang, den kein anderer Anbieter in dieser Form replizieren kann.
Jetzt ist der perfekte Zeitpunkt, um einzusteigen – und mitzugestalten, wie Bildung in Deutschland neu gedacht wird. Bist Du dabei?

über die rolle

Als  Dozent:in für Online Marketing & E-Commerce (m/w/d) gestaltest Du digitale Weiterbildung mit unmittelbarem Impact. Du unterrichtest live im virtuellen Klassenzimmer, vermittelst anwendungsorientiertes Wissen – und begleitest Menschen auf ihrem Weg in zukunftssichere Jobs der digitalen Marketingwelt.

Du bringst Praxiserfahrung in der Branche mit, verstehst, wie Kampagnen funktionieren, Algorithmen ticken und Tools genutzt werden. Gleichzeitig hast Du Freude daran, Menschen zu begleiten, zu befähigen und strukturiert weiterzubringen – auch, wenn sie noch ganz am Anfang stehen.

deine aufgaben

  • Live-Unterricht & Praxisvermittlung: Du gestaltest interaktive Online-Live-Sessions und vermittelst Fachwissen aus dem digitalen Marketingalltag – von Performance-Kampagnen über Content Creation bis hin zu SEO, SEA, E-Mail-Marketing, E-Commerce oder CRM.

  • Curriculum-Umsetzung & Didaktik: Du bereitest Inhalte auf Basis existierender Standard-Unterlagen entlang vorgegebener Module methodisch sinnvoll auf – klar, verständlich und arbeitsmarktnah. Du gibst Raum für Praxisbeispiele und aktuelle Cases.

  • Teilnehmendenbegleitung & Prüfungsvorbereitung: Du gibst Orientierung, motivierst, erklärst, wiederholst, vereinfachst – und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Teilnehmer:innen die nötige Sicherheit für den Berufseinstieg gewinnen.

  • Qualitätssicherung & Feedback: Du gibst didaktisches und inhaltliches Feedback zurück, wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Lehrformate mit und gestaltest unsere digitalen Lernprozesse aktiv mit.

  • Austausch im Dozent:innenteam: Du bist Teil eines kollaborativen Teams, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt, Wissen teilt und eine neue Form des digitalen Lehrens und Lernens etabliert.

das bringst du mit

  • Praxis aus dem Online-Marketing- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld: Du kennst Tools wie Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, Mailchimp, Shopify, Canva oder Hubspot – und kannst deren Anwendung sicher vermitteln.

  • Didaktisches Gespür: Du erklärst verständlich, strukturiert und motivierend – auch für Einsteiger:innen und heterogene Gruppen.

  • Digitale Affinität: Du fühlst Dich in virtuellen Klassenräumen wohl, nutzt Tools souverän und bist offen für neue Lernformate.

  • Haltung & Kommunikationsstärke: Du arbeitest lösungsorientiert, wertschätzend und klar – und möchtest Deine Erfahrung an Menschen weitergeben, die neu durchstarten.

  • Sprachkompetenz: Du verfügst über hervorragende Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C2); Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

  • Zertifizierte Pädagogische Eignung & Erfahrung: Du bringst mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in der Erwachsenenbildung mit, verfügst über fundierte fachliche Expertise in Deinem Themenbereich und hast idealerweise Deine pädagogische Eignung durch eine IHK-zertifizierte Ausbildung (z. B. AEVO-Schein) nachgewiesen.

was wir dir bieten

  • Sinnstiftende Tätigkeit mit unmittelbarem Impact: Du hilfst Menschen dabei, im digitalen Arbeitsmarkt Fuß zu fassen – und gestaltest echte Perspektiven mit.
  • 100 % Remote, 100 % digitalfähig: Du arbeitest vollständig ortsunabhängig – mit Tools und Strukturen, die funktionieren.
  • Gestaltungsfreiheit & pädagogischer Raum: Du bringst Dich ein, entwickelst Formate mit und gestaltest digitalen Unterricht aktiv mit.
  • Faire Vergütung & Perspektive: Du wirst leistungsgerecht bezahlt – mit Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und langfristiger Sicherheit im Bildungsverbund.
  • Teamkultur mit Haltung: Du wirst Teil eines professionellen, engagierten und offenen Teams – mit flachen Hierarchien und kollegialer Unterstützung.

unser bekenntnis zur chancengleichheit

Wir bei Talentspring sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechtsidentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Talentspring steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor. Uns ist es besonders wichtig, das jede:r sich zu seinem/ihrem vollsten Potential entwickelt und in keinster Weise Benachteiligung erfährt. Wir sind stolz auf unser diverses Team und stellen sicher, dass wir in jeder Besetzung diese gelebte Diversität auch erfüllen.

mehr zum bewerbungsprozess

Bereit, mit uns Zukunft zu gestalten? - JETZT BEWERBEN IN UNTER 2 MINUTEN

Du möchtest mit Deiner Arbeit echten Impact schaffen und Menschen auf ihrem Weg in eine sichere, digitale Berufszukunft begleiten? Dann möchten wir Dich kennenlernen.

Sende uns einfach Deinen Lebenslauf (ohne Anschreiben) an karim@talentspring-academy.com oder bewirb Dich direkt über unser Karriereportal – wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden bei Dir zurück.

Collaborative – Stronger together

Aider les dirigeants de PME et les indépendants à optimiser leur situation financière ainsi que la gestion de leur société.

Tes responsabilités en tant que Responsable de fiduciaire :

1. La gestion des clients

  • Tu rassures et fidélises les clients.
  • Tu gères et développes le portefeuille client

2. La gestion opérationnelle

  • Tu intègres les processus de travail de Fiscal Team
  • Tu es responsable du suivi des dossiers comptables et fiscaux de nos clients PME de A à Z.

3. La gestion d’équipe

  • Tu impliques et accompagnes les collaborateurs dans l’intégration de Fiscal Team
  • Tu coaches les équipes au quotidien

Le tout en contribuant activement au développement stratégique du groupe Fiscal Team en partenariat avec les associés.

Te reconnais-tu ?

Ton background

  • Tu es diplômé en comptabilité et en fiscalité
  • Tu possèdes une expérience équivalente à 8 ans dans le domaine
  • Tu es expert en optimisation fiscale
  • Tu as géré des équipes comptables/financières avec succès – Idéalement, tu as déjà occupé un poste similaire
  • Un titre IPCF, IEC ou ITAA est un atout

Ton sens du contact

  • Tu fais preuve d’assurance dans tes relations, tes clients se sentent en confiance avec toi
  • Tu anticipes et comprends les besoins des clients pour leur fournir les conseils les plus avisés
  • Tu écoutes avec bienveillance et tu communiques de manière claire et convaincante
  • Tu sais te montrer persuasif en t’adaptant à ton interlocuteur

Ton leadership

  • Tu suscites l’enthousiasme en partageant ta vision partout où tu passes
  • Chacun a des besoins différents, tu adaptes ton style de direction en fonction des circonstances
  • Tu sais stimuler les capacités des autres en leur prodiguant des feedbacks constructifs et en leur confiant des missions qui les incitent à se dépasser
  • Initier et gérer le changement : pour toi le statu quo n’existe pas, tu reconnais le besoin de changement et tu l’accompagnes dans tous ses aspects
  • Tu es toujours à l’affût des idées nouvelles et des innovations

Ce que nous attendons de toi :

  • Un appétit féroce d’être le meilleur en compta et optimisation fiscale
  • Une motivation sans limites afin d’être ambassadeur de Fiscal Team à tout moment
  • Une passion pour le travail en équipe et l’innovation
  • Une envie secrète de fermer son laptop le vendredi pour dévaliser le frigo du bureau et organiser un apéro surprise

Dans quel environnement arrives-tu ?

Chez Fiscal Team, en plus d’un cadre de travail agréable, confortable et challengeant, tu trouveras :

  • De la liberté pour modeler ta fonction
  • De l’autonomie pour réaliser tes ambitions
  • Des projets bien au-delà de la compta

Chez Fiscal Team, tu es responsable de ton boulot, de ton planning, de tes clients – Chacun sa personnalité, la hiérarchie laisse place à un mode de gouvernance partagée. Cette approche nous permet d’atteindre ensemble un objectif commun, dans le respect des personnes, en préservant la diversité des points de vue et des apports de chacun.

Chez Fiscal Team, nous accordons beaucoup d’importance à l’ambiance et au bien-être, viens donc aussi partager avec nous :

  • L’apéro du vendredi
  • Le barbecue de printemps
  • Notre team building désormais légendaire au soleil ou à la neige

Fiscal Team en quelques mots…

Fiscal Team c’est 5 sites, 5 associés, 30 collaborateurs, une moyenne d’âge de 35 ans.

Nos bureaux se situent à Corbais, Braine l’Alleud, Watermael-Boitsfort, Schaerbeek et Liège.

Dans un environnement fiscal complexe et en constance évolution, notre bureau d’experts-comptables a fait de l’optimisation fiscale des dirigeants de PME et des indépendants sont cheval de bataille.

La rémunération, l’octroi d’un loyer, les droits d’auteur ou encore les options sur actions sont autant de recettes qui permettent à nos clients de savourer une assiette fiscale juste et équilibrée – Nous sommes les champions de l’optimisation !

Une fiduciaire 2.0 ? Nous sommes la fiduciaire la plus avancée en matière de digitalisation. Chez nous, la comptabilité se fait en ligne – Via MyFiscalTeam, nos clients disposent d’une comptabilité mise à jour sous 24h et gagnent un temps considérable. Nos collaborateurs peuvent ainsi se concentrer sur l’activité pour laquelle ils ont une vraie valeur ajoutée : le conseil.

Nos valeurs ?

  • Transparence : nous prônons la transparence à tous les niveaux afin de responsabiliser nos collaborateurs et d’établir la confiance avec nos clients et nos partenaires.
  • Performance : nous voulons toujours atteindre nos objectifs. Notamment en utilisant, mais aussi en créant des outils performants.
  • Créativité : nous stimulons en permanence la créativité au sein de notre entreprise, afin d’offrir des solutions innovantes.
  • Sécurité : la sécurisation et la protection des informations et des données de nos clients sont pour nous une priorité absolue.

Nous avons attisé ta curiosité ? Tu trouveras tous les détails sur notre site : fiscalteam.be

NOUS T’AVONS CONCQUIS ?Nous t’invitons à envoyer ta candidature via le lien : https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/FiscalTeam/743999740499984-responsable-en-fiduciaire

Voici la procédure pour optimiser ta candidature :

  • N’utilise pas « Postulez facilement »
  • Complète uniquement la partie « Informations personnelles »
  • Télécharge ton CV dans la partie « CV »
  • Dans « Votre message au responsable de l’embauche », écris-nous un petit mot sur tes motivations pour ce poste

Au plaisir de te lire et de te voir éventuellement rejoindre notre équipe !

L’équipe Fiscal Team

Freelance | Lieu : Région Bruxelloise

Ta carrière est guidée par la comptabilité et l’optimisation fiscale, tu souhaites partager ton expérience en l’alliant avec ton leadership et ton côté « intrapreneur » ?

Tu souhaites être un acteur majeur du déploiement d’une fiduciaire en pleine expansion, tournée vers la digitalisation et le sens du service aux clients ?

Fiscal Team, notre fiduciaire 2.0 te propose l’opportunité dont tu rêves…

raw.title: Email Systems Engineer (DevOps)
raw.excerpt: We are a fully remote team seeking a skilled Email Systems Engineer with a DevOps mindset to join our team.
raw.description:
We are a fully remote team seeking a skilled Email Systems Engineer with a DevOps mindset to join our team. You will be responsible for managing, optimizing, and scaling our email infrastructure (SMTP, IMAP, Postfix, Haraka), ensuring high deliverability rates, and maintaining the reliability and security of our email systems. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with our development team to integrate and innovate email-related solutions while contributing to the scalability of our platform.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain email server infrastructure (Postfix, Haraka).

  • Manage email protocols such as SMTP, IMAP, and POP3 to ensure seamless operation.

  • Implement and optimize email authentication standards (SPF, DKIM, DMARC).

  • Support the Dev team with DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Monitor and troubleshoot email deliverability issues, resolving reputation or bounce problems.

  • Ensure the email infrastructure meets security and compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, CAN-SPAM).

  • Automate routine maintenance tasks to improve efficiency and system reliability.

  • Maintain documentation of system configurations, processes, and best practices.

  • Stay updated on industry trends and propose improvements to our email architecture.

Requirements

Technical Skills:

  • Strong experience with email systems and protocols (Postfix, Haraka, Dovecot, Cyrus, SMTP, IMAP).

  • Proficiency in Linux server administration.

  • Experience with DNS management, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC configuration.

  • Knowledge of email deliverability strategies, reputation monitoring, and anti-spam measures.

  • Familiarity with DevOps tools (Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and CI/CD workflows.

  • Experience with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, or similar).

  • Programming/scripting skills in Python.

  • Understanding of database management systems (PostgreSQL).

Soft Skills:

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

  • Self-driven and able to work independently in a remote environment.

Highlights

Be part of a rapidly growing startup revolutionizing email deliverability. Work with a passionate team, shape critical email systems, and enjoy flexible hours and a remote-friendly setup.

raw.excerpt: About UsSophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services.
raw.description:
About Us

Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.
Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.
Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com.

Role Summary

The Expansion & Vertical Marketing Manager owns and scales the global expansion marketing strategy and programs within the GTM organization. This role has end-to-end accountability for product-led expansion and vertical execution - driving attach, upsell, and cross-sell across our portfolio while helping to define how Sophos shows up in priority industries. You’ll design scalable, AI-enabled expansion programs rooted in real customer outcomes and aligned to GTM priorities to accelerate growth within the existing customer base.

What You Will Do

    Develop scalable portfolio expansion & cross‑sell marketing frameworks

  • Translate product-led expansion strategy into scalable marketing programs across MDR, endpoint, firewall, cloud, and identity - driving attach, upsell, cross-sell, and portfolio adoption within the existing customer base.
  • Build repeatable execution frameworks that connect product value, customer maturity signals, and field GTM motion.

    • Build vertical marketing strategy for priority industries

  • Establish the vertical marketing strategy for priority industries using sales priorities, customer outcomes, and market signals to guide focus.
  • Translate industry context - buyer needs, regulatory pressure, threat landscape, and maturity- into clear use cases, narratives, and executable programs.

    • Build AI enabled, insight driven programs

  • Use performance data, customer signals, and AI assisted insight to inform where expansion and vertical programs should focus and how they evolve over time.
  • Design programs that scale efficiently through automation, intelligence, and clear activation guidance.

    • Translate strategy into execution that drives revenue

  • Package expansion and vertical strategies into clear plays, guidance, and activation frameworks that sales, partners, and field teams can easily adopt in market.
  • Define success metrics tied to expansion outcomes (e.g., attach rates, cross sell penetration, influenced pipeline), and continuously optimize based on results.

What You Will Bring

  • 4–7+ years of experience in Customer Marketing, Growth Marketing, or Expansion Marketing.
  • Proven experience owning product‑led expansion motions, including attach, upsell, cross sell, or portfolio adoption across complex product environments.
  • Strong understanding of how to align marketing strategy to sales and customer success priorities.
  • An operational mindset, with the ability to design repeatable programs, clear plays, and scalable execution models.
  • Experience using data and AI assisted insight to guide program focus, prioritization, and optimization.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex products and customer needs into clear expansion narratives.
  • Experience in cybersecurity, enterprise SaaS, or a technical B2B environment is a plus.
In the United States, the base salary for this role ranges from $113,000 to $189,000. In addition to base salary, we offer additional compensation including bonus eligibility and a comprehensive benefits package.  A candidate’s specific pay within this range will depend on a variety of factors, including job-related skills, training, location, experience, relevant education, certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

Logistics at full potential.

At GXO, we’re constantly looking for talented individuals at all levels who can deliver the caliber of service our company requires. You know that a positive work environment creates happy employees, which boosts productivity and dedication. On our team, you’ll have the support to excel at work and the resources to build a career you can be proud of.

We’re always on the lookout for leaders who will provide inspiration and guidance, as well as ensure organizational policies and procedures are understood and followed. As the Manager, Facilities Engineering, you will ensure the proper turnover of the building, all equipment, and required certifications/licenses for operational use of the facility. If you’re ready to embrace the challenge of working for a global company, we have the opportunity for you at GXO.

Pay, benefits and more.

We are eager to attract the best, so we offer competitive compensation and a generous benefits package, including full health insurance (medical, dental and vision), 401(k), life insurance, disability, PTO and more.

What you’ll do on a typical day:

  • Handle new interior facility construction (upfit), remodel/reconfiguration activities and shutdowns within the North American region
  • Manage project budgets and timelines to ensure projects are completed on time and budget
  • Provide project weekly status reporting updates to internal and external stakeholders

What you need to succeed at GXO:

At a minimum, you’ll need:

  • 5 to 7 years of experience in a construction project management role for a 3PL/Warehouse Logistics Operations or similar.
  • Experience managing Architectural/Engineering design (MEP) and the permitting process through the local and state jurisdictions (AHJ)
  • Knowledge of building codes (IBC), fire codes (NFPA, IFC), ADA, EPA and OSHA regulations

It’d be great if you also have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management or engineering
  • Knowledge of hazardous material storage requirements
  • Experience installing material handling equipment (sorters, conveyors and required infrastructure)

We engineer faster, smarter, leaner supply chains.

GXO is a leading provider of cutting-edge supply chain solutions to the most successful companies in the world. We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team – energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer including Disabled/Veterans.

GXO adheres to CDC, OSHA and state and local requirements regarding COVID safety. All employees and visitors are expected to comply with GXO policies which are in place to safeguard our employees and customers.

All applicants who receive a conditional offer of employment may be required to take and pass a pre-employment drug test.

raw.description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

Role Scope

Acts as an individual contributor with significant autonomy
Responsible for building and maintaining customer relationships within a defined geographic area
Represents the company at relevant professional events and engagements as appropriate

Key Responsibilities

Sales Performance & Territory Management

  • Achieve coverage, frequency, and sales targets within the assigned territory
  • Develop and execute a territory business plan, including clear objectives and action plans
  • Monitor sales performance and implement corrective actions as needed

Customer Engagement & Scientific Exchange

  • Build and maintain strong professional relationships with healthcare professionals, key opinion leaders, and relevant stakeholders
  • Communicate product value through scientifically balanced and compliant discussions
  • Promote the appropriate and responsible use of company products

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate effectively with medical manager, marketing and other internal stakeholders on strategic initiatives
  • Contribute to cross-functional projects and ensure alignment on key priorities

Market Insights & Analysis

  • Analyze sales and market data to generate actionable insights
  • Contribute to market understanding and support data-driven decision-making
  • Share insights and best practices with the wider team

Project Leadership & Team Contribution

  • Take ownership of selected projects or initiatives within the team
  • Act as a role model, contributing to a high-performance team culture

Training & Development

  • Contribute to the development of team capabilities through knowledge sharing and training activities
  • Maintain and continuously develop personal product, market, and functional expertise

Operational & Administrative Responsibilities

  • Manage territory budgets in line with company guidelines
  • Ensure timely and accurate completion of administrative tasks, including reporting, CRM updates, and expense management

Compliance

  • Operate in full compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and company policies
  • Ensure all activities are conducted in accordance with internal compliance standards and external regulatory requirements

Knowledge & Competencies

The Senior Therapeutic Specialist demonstrates strong expertise in pharmaceutical or healthcare sales, combined with deep knowledge in breast oncology. With a proven track record of success in competitive markets, the individual applies strong influencing and negotiation skills to drive results.

Maintains up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, competitor activities, and treatment protocols, and is able to critically evaluate the benefits and limitations of different therapeutic options (e.g., efficacy, dosing, duration, cost considerations). Engages in meaningful scientific dialogue with healthcare professionals and asks insightful questions to strengthen understanding.

Serves as a designated technical specialist for assigned products and therapeutic areas, specifically breast oncology and gastroenterology, as well as patient needs, facilitating thorough education and meaningful engagement with key stakeholders.
Proactively identifies business challenges and opportunities, develops appropriate solutions, and communicates recommendations clearly to internal stakeholders, including sales and marketing leadership.

Demonstrates strong understanding of external market dynamics and internal organizational processes, and effectively navigates cross-functional structures to execute business plans.

Works independently with a high level of accountability, demonstrating initiative and ownership in driving performance and results.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (BA or BS) required
  • Typically 6–8 years of relevant pharmaceutical or healthcare sales experience
  • Minimum of 4 years in specialty sales or within the relevant therapeutic area
  • At least 2 years of experience as a Therapeutic Specialist preferred
  • Completion of Norwegian pharmaceutical sales certifications as required

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)

It is the policy of Gilead Sciences, Inc. and its subsidiaries and affiliates (collectively "Gilead" or the "Company") to recruit select and employ the most qualified persons available for positions throughout the Company. Except if otherwise provided by applicable law, all employment actions relating to issues such as compensation, benefits, transfers, layoffs, returns from layoffs, company-sponsored training, education assistance, social and recreational programs are administered on a non-discriminatory basis (i.e. without regard to protected characteristics or prohibited grounds, which may include an individual’s gender, race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, creed, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, medical condition, veteran status, and age, unless such protection is prohibited by federal, state, municipal, provincial, local or other applicable laws). Gilead also prohibits discrimination based on any other characteristics protected by applicable laws.

“Ehara taku toa i te toa takitahi, engari he toa takitini.”
My strength is not that of a single warrior, but that of many

Our kaimahi are passionate people, each driven to contribute to better health outcomes, with a focus on priority populations. We are focused on hiring kaimahi who live and work in the communities they serve.

Whakarongorau Aotearoa’s commitment to understanding and improving mana taurite (equal status) starts with the understanding of self and how we, as health professionals, think and behave each minute of each day to serve the health needs for Aotearoa.

We are committed to ensuring our workforce reflects the community we support.

Ko wai mātou | About us

Whakarongorau Aotearoa (Whakarongorau), a social enterprise, is a virtual health and social services organisation with a proven record of connecting people seamlessly with care when they need it.

Whakarongorau has the privilege of running free to the public, virtual health, mental health, and social services for the people of Aotearoa. We want to give everyone in Aotearoa the opportunity for wellness. We focus on the connected world of digital care, where we can help join all the dots, and select the right services, advice, support and help for the right need.

We use our healthy imagination to solve big problems by understanding the tiny ways that people are blocked from getting the care they deserve. Our imagination comes from our people and our partners and their drive to never give up.

raw.excerpt: what we doThe capabilities of current generation quantum devices are still quite underwhelming.
raw.description:
what we do

The capabilities of current generation quantum devices are still quite underwhelming. They are slow and error-prone; and scientists spend an enormous amount of time just optimizing their setups. We are gathering the brightest minds to solve this! Join us on our journey to become the world’s leading scientific machine learning company. We work remotely, and meet physically once every 2 months for planning, brainstorming and shared meals.

why we need you

You are expected to take co-ownership of the core library of our QruiseOS product and its integration with control electronics APIs and our QruiseML product. QruiseOS is an integrated environment allowing developers of Quantum Computers and other Quantum technologies to perform their daily tasks of characterizing, calibrating and monitoring their quantum devices, while giving direct insights on how these devices operate. Most of our software is written in Python. The broad portfolio of our offerings is built on the foundation of a high-fidelity differentiable numerical simulator of sophisticated quantum devices and precision microwave electronics, which works in close coordination with a variety of optimization processes. We are not only expanding our suite of classical and ML-assisted optimization algorithms but also scaling our simulator to efficiently utilize high-performance CPU and GPU clusters. These tools are developed for hybrid (on-premise + cloud-native) deployment from the ground up, so we need software engineers with a very broad background.

your profile

  • At least 3-5 years of experience in backend/server-side development, preferably in Python is required.
  • Experience in building cloud native tech stacks, preferably for AI/ML applications is preferred.
  • Experience in docker, microservices and AWS is preferred.
  • We make extensive use of modern agentic AI based development processes (claude code / codex / opencode) and expect you to be comfortable and proficient in using these tools.
  • Experience in accelerated computing on CPU/GPU clusters is an added bonus.
  • Experience in developing ML workflows and data lakes is useful but not required.
  • A good intuition about automatic differentiation, optimization, numerical modelling and integration (esp. ODEs) is useful but not required.
  • Since we are 100% remote, strong communication skills and regular knowledge sharing are a must.
  • You must already reside or be willing to relocate near EU time-zones (CET±1).

what we need for your application

Your CV is a good start. But, what we’d really like to see is that you have a proven track record of projects and work in the relevant field. So if you can send us a link to your GitHub, recent projects or real-world examples of what you have done so far, that is what really interests us. Before a possible interview, please think about the following:

  • What is something you accomplished which you are really proud of?
  • What technological developments are you excited about?
  • What are the things that you have taught yourself?
  • What is something you would like to learn or improve in the near future?

perks & benefits

  • 30 days of paid vacation a year
  • Remote work by default
  • Choose your own work computer
  • Budget for home office equipment
  • Flexible working hours
  • Travel / Co-working space cost reimbursement
  • Regular company-paid team-events

About Lantern

Lantern is the specialty care platform connecting people with the best care when they need it most. By curating a Network of Excellence comprised of the nation's top specialists for surgery, cancer care, infusions and more, Lantern delivers excellent care with significant cost savings to employers and their workforces. Lantern also pairs members with a dedicated care team, including Care Advocates and nurses, for the entirety of their care journey, helping them get back to good health, back to their families and back to work. With convenient access to specialists nationwide, Lantern means quality care is within driving distance for most. Lantern is trusted by the nation's largest employers to deliver care to more than 6 million members across the country. Learn more about us at lanterncare.com.

About You:

  • You use LOGIC in your decision making and understand that progress is critical to making change. You focus on the execution of your content while balancing a fast-paced environment and you take the time to celebrate both the small & big wins.
  • INCLUSION is a core tenant of your personal beliefs. A diverse and inclusive environment is incredibly important to you. You understand and desire to be a part of a diverse team with different experiences and perspectives & you cherish the differences in each individual that you interact with.
  • You have the GRIT, drive and ambition to tackle big problems. Big problems require big ideas and a team that supports new ideas.
  • You care deeply for your customers are driven to keep HUMANITY in all decisions. Your customers aren’t just the individuals using your product. They are the driving factor in your motivation to make a change.
  • Integrity guides you in life. Focusing on the TRUTH vs. giving people the answers they want to hear.
  • You thrive in a Team Environment. Collaboration is key in innovation and creating change.

These pillars of LIGHT are a reminder to our team that we are making a difference by providing guidance and support in navigating the often complex and confusing landscape of healthcare. We hope that through this LIGHT, individuals can find their way to the best care, resources, and support they need to get back to life.

If this sounds like you, we would love to connect to speak further about career opportunities at Lantern.

Please apply to our role & someone from our Talent Acquisition Team will reach out to help you navigate our interview process.

Solutions Consultant

The Solutions Consulting will serve as a thought leader andleverage deep subject matter and industry expertise to deliver tailored solutions to our clients, resulting in high win rates and long-term client satisfaction.

Location: Remote | USA | Travel Required

Responsibilities:

  • The Solutions Consultant will be a key deal strategist. Collaborate with Sales, Client Success and Consultant Relations to analyze prospective and current client needs, propose best-fit solutions, and help execute on a tailored growth/retention plan for the opportunities to which they are assigned. 
  • Serve as a resident expert on product offering questions (current and roadmap), savings projections and other analytics, network footprint, quality methodology, technical integrations, member experience, success stories and general industry knowledge for the Commercial teams and prospective clients. They will tailor best practice recommendations around plan design, ecosystem integrations, targeted marketing, etc. to the prospect/client based on their expertise.
  • Support growth and retention by providing expertise throughout the sales and renewal/upsell process, including evaluating best fit solutions in collaboration with Health Plan and Channel Sales/Client Management/Consultant Relations, and ensuring thorough discovery is completed.
  • Act as a bridge to the rest of the organization, helping to bring together the appropriate internal stakeholders to support the deal (e.g., Consultant Relations and Channel Partnerships), and taking a key role in supporting presentations, product demonstrations and RFP’s. 
  • Work internally to solution complex and/or non-standard prospective client requirements, across Product, Network, Analytics, Implementation, Operations, Legal, Finance, Member and Partner Marketing, Client Success and Clinical teams. Serve as a bridge between the sales process and ongoing Client Success to ensure proposal commitments are identified and delivered upon. Understand and answer custom RFP questions and follow-up inquiries/BAFO requests to create standard responses that are field-tested.
  • Share learnings and themes from the field back with cross-functional leadership for broader adoption into product packaging and go-to-market processes.

Requirements:

  • 10-15 years of professional experience in consulting and/or customer-facing role in health and benefits and/or similar years of experience as a Solutions Consultant/Architect in digital health and benefits. 
  • Robust strategic thinking and creative problem-solving skills; solution oriented. 
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to confidently convey complex information and messages to a broad and diverse audience, both internal and external. 
  • Strong analytical experience working with and visualizing data.
  • Clear understanding of the mechanics of self-funded medical plans and the relationships between health plans/third party administrators, health care providers, and plan sponsors.
  • Effective interpersonal skills with the ability to work independently and within a team environment, both externally facing and behind the scenes. 
  • Comfortable working in a high-growth, fast-changing environment; organized, adaptable, diligent, and self-motivated. 
  • Passion for Lantern’s mission and collaborating with others. 

Strong Candidates will:

  • Experience working with medical claims data to project savings/program impact.
  • Knowledge of broader ecosystem of point solutions and health care disruptors selling to self-funded employers.
  • Experience in delivering an engaging and impactful product demo while articulating the value for all stakeholders (members, partners, employers). 
  • Comfortable solutioning and designing non-standard employer requests by taking into consideration internal and external perspectives and collaborating across stakeholders. 
  • Excels at working cross-functionally and is able to effectively influence decision making. 
  • Ability to adopt continuous improvement mindset and actively contribute to the processes and procedures of the larger Commercial team. 
  • Experience in an early / growth stage business.

About Very
(Remote – Mexico)

Very is a fully distributed technology firm led by expert problem-solvers who create efficient, scalable solutions that move commercial, industrial, and consumer products from pilot to production in record time.

We believe that real innovation happens in the grind — working shoulder to shoulder with clients who are building the future. Our team thrives on that energy. When we’re not helping clients deliver business-critical outcomes, we’re refining our craft and celebrating what it means to do hard things well.

We’ve built a collaborative, tight-knit culture that thrives in both remote and in-person settings. We’ve won numerous workplace awards over the years, including Great Place to Work certification and recognition from Parity.org as a Best Company for Women to Advance.

Our clients include well-known brands like Vizio, Peloton, Clear, iHeart Radio, and Fellowes — all determined to leverage connected devices and AI to drive meaningful impact. Our job is simple: help them win.

About This Role

We’re hiring a full-time, skilled Senior Software Engineer specialized in React/Typescript for one of our partners.

In this role, you’ll play a key role in building and maintaining secure, scalable applications that support critical customer and business needs. You’ll work across the presentation layer — from implementing complex front-end features to consuming and shaping API contracts while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

This role is hands-on: you’ll translate requirements into well-designed solutions, write production-ready code, participate in code reviews, and contribute to the overall reliability and performance of our systems. You’ll also help support our applications in production through on-call rotations and proactive issue resolution.

This position is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving real-world problems, working in modern web environments, and contributing to applications end-to-end.
This is not an easy role. You’ll work in complex domains, under real deadlines, and with clients who expect you to bring clarity, confidence, and results. If you find satisfaction in doing hard things well — in solving tough problems, building real systems, and helping others rise to the challenge — you’ll fit right in.

What You’ll Be Working On

You’ll be focusing on building and enhancing complex, user-facing applications using modern front-end technologies. You’ll:

  • Write production-grade React/Typescript code that meets high standards for maintainability, security, and observability.
  • Implement comprehensive testing strategies (e.g., unit and end-to-end testing).
  • Collaborate across engineering, design, and product to deliver high-quality outcomes.
  • Identify and proactively address potential technical or operational risks before they impact customers.

The core technology focus is on deep expertise in React and TypeScript, leveraging tools like Vite, Expo, WebSockets, and Progressive Web Apps.

Outcomes

  1. Deliver High-Quality Features: Ship secure, reliable code that meets requirements, adheres to standards, and delivers measurable business value.
  2. Strengthen System Reliability: Improve observability, performance, and operational excellence across services and components.
  3. Support Cross-Functional Delivery: Collaborate effectively with lead engineers, designers, PMs, and client stakeholders.
  4. Raise the Bar: Contribute to better patterns, tooling, and engineering standards across teams.
  5. Enhance Customer Success: Proactively identify and resolve technical issues that could impact system behavior or user experience.

Responsibilities

  • Implement features across the frontend application
  • Participate in technical design discussions and contribute to architectural decisions.
  • Write clean, scalable, and secure code following Very’s engineering standards.
  • Create and maintain automated tests across all layers of the stack.
  • Contribute to frontend deployment pipelines and application-level logging/monitoring.
  • Participate in code reviews, offering constructive feedback that improves overall quality.
  • Support documentation and knowledge sharing within teams.

Requirements

General Experience

  • BS or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, or demonstrated equivalent expertise in the required technologies.
  • Full software development lifecycle experience, including requirements, design, implementation, testing, and deployment of modern web applications.

Technical Proficiency

  • Deep expertise with frontend technologies including React, Expo, Vite and TypeScript

Requirements

  • Must reside and be authorized to work in the location specified in the job's post.

Skills

In addition to experience and technical skills, these are the critical skills we look for in all technical roles, and how they should be demonstrated at the Lead level.

  • Client Obsessed: Keeps the client’s success front and center. Measures technical choices by their business impact.
  • Communicates Effectively: Expert communicator who informs, engages, and aligns diverse audiences.

raw.description:
ACCESSIBILITY SPECIALIST (Contract)

As an Accessibility Specialist, you will be responsible for ensuring the efficient and effective creation, remediation, and validation of accessible digital documents and materials. Your work will focus heavily on PDF remediation and the development of accessible files that meet established accessibility standards. You will collaborate with production and content teams to support accessibility compliance across a range of educational and digital products.

This is a remote, contract-based role. Selected candidates will join a vetted contractor pool and will be engaged on a project-by-project basis as work becomes available.

Responsibilities

  • Remediate PDF documents and other digital files to meet accessibility standards (WCAG and Section 508).
  • Create accessible documents from source files (e.g., InDesign, Word, PowerPoint, HTML).
  • Conduct accessibility audits and document compliance issues with clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Perform quality assurance self- and peer-checks to validate accessibility compliance prior to delivery.
  • Write Accessibility Conformance Reports (ACRs) using Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs).
  • Collaborate with production artists, designers, and project managers to resolve accessibility issues.
  • Interpret and apply accessibility requirements across a variety of content types, including eLearning assets.
  • Stay current with accessibility standards, tools, and best practices.

Experience, Education & Certifications

  • 2–5 years of experience creating and remediating accessible digital documents (required).
  • Strong working knowledge of WCAG (2.1 or 2.2) and Section 508 standards.
  • Experience using accessibility and remediation software (e.g., Adobe Acrobat Pro, CommonLook, axesPDF, PAC, screen readers such as JAWS or NVDA).
  • Demonstrated experience conducting accessibility audits and documenting findings.
  • Experience writing or contributing to VPATs and ACRs.
  • Familiarity with document creation tools such as Adobe InDesign, Google apps, Microsoft Word, and PowerPoint.
  • ADS (Accessible Document Specialist) certification preferred but not required.
  • Familiarity with math accessibility.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow complex specifications and standards.
  • Excellent written communication skills, particularly for documenting compliance and remediation work.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple assignments with varying timelines.
  • A Google email account may be required to perform the role.

Tools and Requirements

  • Contractors must supply their own access to accessibility remediation and testing software.
  • Reliable internet connection and ability to work remotely.
  • Ability to receive and respond to project-based assignments in a timely manner.

Application Requirements

  • Resume highlighting relevant accessibility and remediation experience.
  • Sample Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) previously completed by the applicant.

Leveling

  • Candidates may be placed as either Accessibility Specialist or Lead Accessibility Specialist based on experience, demonstrated skill, and assessment performance. Responsibilities and compensation will vary accordingly.

[Example] Rates

  • Hourly: $40–75 depending on experience, ADS-certified: $60–90/hr
  • Per-page: $3–10/pp for standard PDFs, $10–25/pp complex layouts with tables, heavy graphics, math
  • Per-page for remediation. Hourly for audits, consulting, and VPAT/ACR writing

AlertMedia, backed by Vista Equity Partners, helps organizations protect their people and businesses through all phases of an emergency. Our award-winning threat intelligence, emergency communication, and travel risk management solutions help companies of all sizes identify, respond to, and recover from critical events faster and more confidently. TripleTen is an online teaching platform that empowers people, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions. Our bootcamps focus on training students in Data Analytics, Data Science, Web Development, Quality Assurance (QA) Engineering, and UX/UI Design — in an accessible and practical way, supporting them until they successfully thrive in a new career.

🚀 Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry.

What is our goal?

We are continuously looking for experienced QA Engineering professionals who want to support and guide our students on their path to becoming professional developers. This is a full-time teaching role with an expectation of 40 hours per week. The schedule can be flexible, but you must be consistently available to support students throughout their learning journey.

How to apply?

Apply here. We review applications on a rolling basis and invite selected candidates to record an introductory video where you answer a few questions, and complete a short technical test task.

If a vacancy is available, we will assign it to you right away; otherwise, we will keep your profile and completed task on file for future opportunities.

Nice to have:
